title: Passing AWS Cloud Practitioner in two weeks

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sixty hours, two weeks, one cloud exam. That's the budget Antoine set himself for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sixty hours sounds like a lot until you realise how much of it was spent playing a game. Wait, a game?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sort of. One of his resources was AWS Cloud Quest, a role-playing course where you solve cloud puzzles. He says it was easier to finish a quest on a tired evening than another lecture chapter.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the secret was mixing formats, not just grinding videos.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Week one was a paid Udemy course, videos plus hands-on labs. Week two was Cloud Quest, the Escape Room on AWS Skill Builder, practice exams, and an exam prep course.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What's an Escape Room doing in exam prep?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It packs exam-style problems into timed challenges. Lighter than yet another quiz, but it gets you used to the format and the pressure.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There's also a tip for people who don't have English as a first language. AWS offers an accommodation called ESL plus thirty, which adds thirty minutes to the exam.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And you have to ask before you book, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. You request it in your AWS Certification account first, then schedule with the extra time included. Antoine even corrects the older Medium version of the post, which said fifty percent.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He booked through Pearson VUE. If you test online, log in at least thirty minutes early, expect a three hundred and sixty degree webcam sweep of your room, and tell the people you live with not to knock.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: After you pass, the Credly badge email arrives two to three days later. Use the same email as your AWS account and you can share it on LinkedIn or your resume.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the takeaway is: variety keeps you moving, and the logistics matter as much as the content.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The full write-up has the study plan, the screenshots and the badge steps.
